assertions.assertion: The denial carries reason code CO-197.
CPT 93229 corresponds to Mobile Cardiac Telemetry.
A clinical indication note exists for this episode.
The patient presents with recurrent episodes of syncope and near-syncope.
The patient has known atherosclerotic heart disease.
Atherosclerotic heart disease is coded as I25.10.
The patient has unspecified atrial fibrillation.
Unspecified atrial fibrillation is coded as I48.91.
Mobile cardiac telemetry is ordered to correlate symptomatic events with potential arrhythmic activity or ischemic changes.
Such arrhythmic or ischemic changes may not be captured on standard ambulatory monitoring.
